title: Returning an Item
introduction: این مکالمه را بخوان و عبارت‌های توضیح مشکل و درخواست تعویض را یاد بگیر.
paragraphs: Customer: Hello. I bought these headphones here yesterday, but they do not work.
Assistant: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Customer: Yes, here it is. I would like to exchange them, if possible.
Assistant: Certainly. Would you prefer a new pair or a refund?
Customer: A new pair, please. The same model is fine.
Assistant: No problem. Let me check our stock.
Customer: Thank you for your help.
Assistant: You're welcome. I hope these work better.
